create_ImagePaths_dataset: create an ImagePaths dataset from a list of image file paths with optional resizing and cropping
create_NumpyPaths_dataset: create a NumpyPaths dataset that loads images from numpy .npy files with preprocessing
use_ConcatDatasetWithIndex: use ConcatDatasetWithIndex to concatenate multiple datasets and retrieve both samples and dataset indices
preprocess_image_with_ImagePaths: preprocess an image by opening, converting to RGB, resizing, cropping, and normalizing pixel values
getitem_ImagePaths: get a preprocessed image dict with labels from an ImagePaths dataset by index
